title.zh: AI Frontiers告终：微软研究路线之争
title.en: AI Frontiers Ends Amid Microsoft Research Strategy Rift

excerpt.zh: AI Frontiers创始成员John Langford称，该团队并入Microsoft AI后走向终结。他将离职归因于研究创新与规模扩张之间的路线冲突，但所供材料未包含微软回应，团队成员及项目的后续安排仍待明确。
excerpt.en: AI Frontiers has ended, John Langford says, citing a clash over research and scaling after its move into Microsoft AI.

text.en: Why AI Frontiers Came to an End

text.zh: AI Frontiers创始成员John Langford在2026年11月的博文中表示，这个微软研究院团队已经告终，他本人也已离职。据其回顾，团队于2023年组建，约有50人，目的是通过更有组织的合作，让研究人员能够更快验证新想法，并建立有说服力的比较基准。
text.en: AI Frontiers founding member John Langford says in a November 2026 blog post that the Microsoft Research group has ended and that he has left the company. According to his account, the group formed in 2023 and had roughly 50 people. It sought to coordinate research so that researchers could test ideas faster and establish stronger baselines for comparison.

text.zh: Langford称，团队于9月初并入Microsoft AI，随后出现研究理念冲突。他认为，新组织侧重通过扩大规模、获取和改进数据来提升模型，而团队希望继续探索新的基础能力。他将这种分歧视为离职的重要原因；这是他的个人叙述，所供材料未包含微软方面的回应。
text.en: Langford says the group moved into Microsoft AI in early September, creating a conflict over research priorities. In his description, the receiving organization emphasized scaling models and acquiring and refining data, while his group wanted to explore new fundamental capabilities. He presents that disagreement as a central reason for leaving. This is his personal account; the supplied material contains no response from Microsoft.

text.zh: 研究成果与规模扩张如何取舍
团队工作包括AutoGen智能体编排框架、Fara计算机操作智能体，以及训练目标、优化器和递归模型结构等方向。Langford还提到向微软研究院内部共享的模型预训练代码库。这些工作说明，团队尝试同时推进智能体应用、基础方法和研究基础设施，但算力供应经常构成瓶颈。
text.en: The group's work included the AutoGen agent orchestration framework, the Fara computer-use agent, and research into training objectives, optimizers and recursive model architectures. Langford also describes a pretraining codebase shared within Microsoft Research. Together, these efforts show an attempt to advance agent applications, fundamental methods and research infrastructure, although access to compute was often a bottleneck.

text.zh: 这场分歧提出的问题是：企业如何在规模扩张的可预测回报与研究创新的不确定收益之间分配资源？Langford援引外部实验，主张架构创新可能降低达到同等能力所需的成本，但节选不足以独立验证其效果。团队告终也不等于所有项目停运；成员去向、项目维护及研究成果能否进入实际产品，仍缺乏完整说明。
text.en: The dispute raises a resource-allocation question: how should companies balance the more predictable returns from scaling with the uncertain gains from research? Langford cites external experiments to argue that architectural innovation could reduce the cost of achieving comparable capabilities, but the excerpt is insufficient to verify those results independently. The group's end also does not establish that every project has stopped. Staff destinations, project maintenance and routes into actual products remain incompletely explained.
